correctness.rationale: D has rank n by connectedness of K_n minus {0,1} and a singleton exception. Its explicit Gram matrix splits into an odd n fixed (n-3)-space plus order-seven irreducible cubic, or an even n one-dimensional stable projection plus a three-chain. Block-power rank identities yield all seven-step Jordan sizes and sharp timing; divisor fixed-space calculations yield odd n least periods 1,2,7,14, with exact basin factors. Two independent checkers passed actual matrix ranks/iterate fixed spaces for n=3..34 and full binary state trajectories for n=3,4,5. Finite checks do not replace the all-n proof.

value.rationale: One missing adjacency in a natural standard complete-subdivision graph changes extinct even-order dynamics into a periodic remnant with a seven-step transient, and changes odd-order period-two recurrence to exact order fourteen. The proof explains the parity mechanism and supplies all-n and all-characteristic-two-field counts of individual temporal orbits, attraction basins, and first-entry shells; this is a natural and structurally motivated fault-sensitivity classification rather than a parameter substitution or an isolated enumeration.
